title: Uncertainty-Aware Candidate Generation for Entity Linking in Cyber Threat Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2611.33086v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Entity Resolution (ER) pipelines often collapse ambiguity into early hard decisions: upstream Named Entity Recognition (NER) selects a single span and type, and downstream Entity Linking (EL) treats that choice as ground truth. This discards valuable information about the ambiguity of the underlying data (e.g., span boundary disagreement and type confusion), leading to brittle systems that fail unpredictably when faced with uncertainty in inputs. Therefore, this work presents a proof-of-concept for uncertainty-aware ER that treats uncertainty as native data that should be preserved and exploited throughout ER pipelines. We (i) capture uncertainty signals in the NER stage and (ii) leverage these signals into the EL stage to improve candidate retrieval under ambiguity. translated_title: 面向网络威胁情报中实体链接的不确定性感知候选生成
translated_abstract: 实体解析（ER）流水线通常在早期的硬性决策中就将模糊性压缩消除：上游的命名实体识别（NER）选择单个文本片段和类型，下游的实体链接（EL）则将该选择当作真实值。这种做法丢弃了关于底层数据模糊性的宝贵信息（例如片段边界不一致和类型混淆），导致系统变得脆弱，在面对输入中的不确定性时会不可预测地失败。因此，本工作提出了一个不确定性感知实体解析的概念验证方案，将不确定性视为应在整个ER流水线中予以保留和利用的原生数据。我们（i）在NER阶段捕获不确定性信号，并（ii）将这些信号传递至EL阶段加以利用，以在模糊情况下改进候选实体检索。我们使用基于BERT的NER模型，并为其增加两个辅助的片段边界预测头，在推理时应用蒙特卡洛（MC）dropout来推导提及级别的三种预测。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种不确定性感知的实体解析方法，通过在NER阶段捕获片段边界与类型的不确定性信号并传递到EL阶段，从而在网络威胁情报场景下改进模糊情况下的候选实体检索。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an uncertainty-aware entity resolution approach that captures uncertainty signals during NER and leverages them in the entity linking stage to improve candidate retrieval under ambiguity in cyber threat intelligence.
